verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli), installable via curl script or Homebrew. It is explicitly built for agents: `--agent` JSON output (the default when piped), `--no-input` for CI, browser OAuth plus headless client-credentials agent login, human/agent profiles, 12 resource groups with approve/submit/edit actions, and packaged agent skills; Ramp's docs index points agents to it for scripted loops. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented (the probe only confirms the repo location).
